facts.text: The Dewberry borders Marion Square, a public park that hosts some of the city's most popular events.
facts.excerpt: Bordering Charleston’s Marion Square, a treasured public park and setting for some of the city’s most popular events

facts.text: The hotel occupies Charleston's L. Mendel Rivers Federal Building (circa 1964), a mid-century modern landmark rescued, restored and reimagined by owner John Dewberry.
facts.excerpt: Honoring the history of Charleston’s landmark L. Mendel Rivers Federal Building (circa 1964), The Dewberry is a mid-century modern landmark _rescued, restored,_ and _reimagined_ by visionary owner John Dewberry.

facts.text: The building was reimagined over eight years by a team of architects and designers.
facts.excerpt: The Dewberry was reimagined over eight years by a team of renowned architects and designers

facts.text: Design details include hand-gilded cranes in the Swanston Room, custom botanical armoires, Vermont-selected marble, vintage Danish furnishings and a bespoke Woka brass chandelier.
facts.excerpt: from hand-gilded cranes in the Swanston Room to custom botanical armoires, Vermont-selected marble, vintage Danish furnishings, and a bespoke Woka brass chandelier

facts.text: Rooms have custom Stickley armoires with botanical patterns, baths of Vermont marble, mattresses imported from Ireland and chef-curated mini-bars.
facts.excerpt: from custom Stickley armoires with botanical patterns and spa-like baths of Vermont marble to sumptuous mattresses imported from Ireland to chef-curated mini-bars

facts.text: The John Derian Flat blends Derian's signature decoupage pieces with vintage-inspired goods and textiles.
facts.excerpt: The John Derian Flat design is a beautiful blend of Derian’s signature decoupage pieces, and vintage-inspired goods and textiles

facts.text: The Charleston Flats sit in the corners of each floor.
facts.excerpt: our light-filled Charleston Flats take their rightful place in the corners of each floor

facts.text: One-Bedroom Suites have a separate bedroom with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Historic Charleston and Marion Square.
facts.excerpt: A separate, sun-filled bedroom has floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Historic Charleston and Marion Square.

facts.text: The extraordinarily tall windows date to when JFK originally commissioned the building.
facts.excerpt: Extraordinarily tall windows date to when JFK originally commissioned this building, providing vertical frames of city views.

facts.text: Citrus Club occupies the hotel's eighth-floor terrace and is the highest rooftop lounge in Charleston.
facts.excerpt: the Citrus Club occupies The Dewberry’s eighth floor terrace and features the highest rooftop lounge in Charleston

facts.text: Citrus Club has 360-degree views over the peninsula.
facts.excerpt: head high to the rooftop cocktail lounge, Citrus Club, for 360-degree views over the peninsula

facts.text: The Living Room is a midcentury space for morning coffee, afternoon cocktails or an evening aperitif.
facts.excerpt: The Living Room is a midcentury dream, a warm, inviting place for everything from morning coffee, afternoon cocktails, or an evening aperitif

facts.text: The Dewberry is the exclusive Charleston hotel partner of Barton & Gray, a private yachting club.
facts.excerpt: We’re delighted to be the exclusive Charleston hotel partner of Barton & Gray

facts.text: Guests can charter a classic Hinckley Talaria yacht to experience Charleston and the barrier islands from the water.
facts.excerpt: Experience Charleston and the barrier islands from the waterways aboard a classic Hinckley Talaria.

facts.text: The concierge can schedule a five-hour beach trip in a Volvo house car with beach chairs, an umbrella, towels and cold waters.
facts.excerpt: schedule your five-hour beach trip, with everything you need — from premium beach chairs and an umbrella to a beach bag filled with plush towels and cold waters

facts.text: Hotel guests can book a privately guided introduction to The Charleston Library Society.
facts.excerpt: hotel guests will have an opportunity to secure a privately guided introduction to The Charleston Library Society

facts.text: Complimentary Volvo house car transportation is offered to select destinations in downtown Charleston, based on availability.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary Volvo house car transportation is offered for select destinations in downtown Charleston, based on availability.

facts.text: Overnight guests can test drive a Volvo house car for up to three hours once during their stay.
facts.excerpt: test drives are available for up to three hours once during your stay

facts.text: The hotel has a fleet of 21-gear Specialized bicycles with racks and baskets for cruising around the peninsula.
facts.excerpt: Complete with racks and baskets, our fleet of premier 21-gear Specialized bicycles are perfect for cruising around the peninsula.

facts.text: The Spa is cypress-lined and offers Natura Bisse facials, hot river stone massages and detoxifying seaweed wraps.
facts.excerpt: From Natura Bissé facials, to hot river stone massages, to detoxifying seaweed wraps

facts.text: The Spa is softly lit, cypress lined and curtain draped.
facts.excerpt: The Spa is softly lit, cypress lined, curtain draped

facts.text: A mat pilates class with a view is held every Saturday in partnership with The Longevity Club.
facts.excerpt: Join us every Saturday for a mat pilates class with a view, in partnership with The Longevity Club.

facts.text: The Shop is a jewel box space with objets d'art, personal and home accessories.
facts.excerpt: A jewel box space showcasing objets d’art, personal, and home accessories

facts.text: Valet parking is available for $58 per night; self-parking is not offered.
facts.excerpt: Valet parking is available for $58 per night; self-parking is not offered.

facts.text: Pets are not permitted, but service animals are welcome.
facts.excerpt: Pets are not permitted, but service animals are welcome in accordance with ADA guidelines.

facts.text: Rollaway beds are not available; cribs can be arranged via the Concierge, subject to availability.
facts.excerpt: Rollaway beds are not available. Cribs and Pack ’n Plays can be arranged via the Concierge, subject to availability.

facts.text: Citrus Club is for guests 21 years of age and older.
facts.excerpt: Citrus Club is for guests 21 years of age and older.

facts.text: Daily housekeeping and evening turndown service are provided.
facts.excerpt: Daily housekeeping and evening turndown service are provided.

facts.text: The Dewberry was named in Conde Nast Traveler's Readers' Choice Awards every year from 2017 to 2026.
The ground-floor brass bar is James Beard-nominated.
